image.alt: Los Carnales Junk Remover professional crew and heavy duty fleet

description: Los Carnales Junk Remover was founded on a simple belief: when people need stuff hauled away, they shouldn't have to worry about whether the job is too big, too messy, or too complicated. Homeowners staring at garages full of junk. Contractors drowning in demolition debris. Property managers facing full property cleanouts. Everyone had the same problem — finding a hauler who would actually show up, work hard, and charge a fair price. That's where we come in.

We built Los Carnales Junk Remover with a heavy duty fleet and a no-nonsense work ethic. Dump trucks ready for the biggest jobs. A team that treats every load like family. And a commitment to doing what we say we'll do — on time, every time. But we didn't stop at hauling. We saw our customers needed more — old windows replaced, new doors installed, rooms that needed fresh paint. So we added those services too.

Today, Los Carnales Junk Remover proudly serves the Bay Area — San Jose and surrounding communities — handling residential junk removal, commercial cleanouts, demolition cleanup, window installation, door installation, and painting projects with the same dependable, professional service that built our reputation. Call or text (209) 684-1072 for your free estimate. Nothing we can't haul. Nothing we can't handle.

items.question: What can you haul away?
items.answer: Everything. Furniture, appliances, demolition waste, yard debris, estate cleanouts, and commercial junk. Nothing we can't haul.

items.answer: Yes. Free, no-obligation estimates on every job. Call or text (209) 684-1072 for your quote — no hidden fees, ever.

items.question: What areas do you serve?
items.answer: The Bay Area — San Jose, CA and surrounding communities including Oakland, Fremont, Sunnyvale, and throughout the region.

items.question: Do you work with contractors?
items.answer: Absolutely. We're contractor-friendly — demolition cleanup, dump truck services, and hauling built for the trades.

items.question: Do you do property cleanouts?
items.answer: Yes. Full property cleanouts for homes, businesses, rental properties, estates, and foreclosures. We handle all the heavy lifting.

items.question: Do you install windows and doors?
items.answer: Yes. We provide professional window installation and door installation for residential and commercial properties. Energy efficient, properly sealed, and built to last.

items.question: Do you do painting projects?
items.answer: Yes. We handle interior and exterior painting for homes and businesses. Fresh, clean, and professionally finished — every time.

items.question: Do you take single items?
items.answer: Yes. No job too small. Single furniture pieces, one appliance, a few boxes — we haul it all. Same professional service regardless of job size.

items.question: How fast can you respond?
items.answer: We pride ourselves on fast response. Call or text for your free estimate and we'll get you scheduled quickly — often same-week.

items.question: How big is your fleet?
items.answer: We run a heavy duty fleet with multiple dump trucks ready for jobs of any size. No job too big — we bring Carnales strength every time.
